column1: # Terms Saudi call-centre agents say, written the way speech recognizers write them for lang "ar".
# A row is here when two Arabic recognizers, reading the same recording, wrote arabic_form identically:
# agreed_rows counts those readings, over transcribed agent turns that a recognizer vote marked trusted.
# The recordings are private, so the counts are the evidence given. A term that agents do not say has no
# row, however the term is spelled in print.
